high_level_description: This image depicts a serene and minimalist scene featuring a stack of smooth, rounded stones balanced on top of each other, resting on a calm body of water. The stones vary slightly in size and color, with the largest at the bottom and progressively smaller ones stacked on top. The reflection of the stones is clearly visible in the water below, creating a symmetrical and tranquil effect. The background consists of a gradient sky that transitions from a darker blue at the top to a lighter hue near the horizon, suggesting either early morning or late evening light.
